snippet.title: Hermit Computer (North Korea Horror Game) Official Trailer 1
snippet.description:
Hermit Computer is a horror-puzzle game set in 2001. Deep within the North Korea, you play as an outsider tasked with extracting critical intelligence using a secretive state-controlled computer operating system.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3638070/Hermit_Computer/
